description: The caller workflows a repo installs, fetched by an installer from the floating major tag the callers pin. `source` is the file's path in this repo; it is installed as .github/workflows/<its file name>, unchanged. Each caller's `uses:` names a reusable workflow of this repo at that tag. All of them live in callers/, so this repo runs none of them.

callers.summary: Runs Claude when a comment says @claude.
Reviews every PR; keep this file's name and path, the other callers match the review run by both.
Fixes a blocking review round on a PR Claude opened.

Merges a PR whose review is CLEAN, or labels it needs-human. Opt-in: needs squash merging, and either 0 required approvals, a GitHub App the gate acts as (FIXDINGS_APP_CLIENT_ID + FIXDINGS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, optional), or the Actions setting that lets GitHub Actions approve pull requests (the gate approves before it merges).
